chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: The mystery drummer Stan King and George Marsh
summary: Kline asks about Stan King, who played drums when Morehouse did not, but Morehouse remembers nothing.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then you came back. And you came back and you did "Take Your Tomorrow," and "Sentimental Baby" and "Love Affair." Okay. And then the next session after that again you weren't there. And for the first time, the name Stan King.
Stan King is a name that keeps popping up in so many of these orchestras. When you weren't playing drum, Stan King would play the drums.
Who was Stan King? Where did he come from?
Yeah, tell me about him. What do you remember about him?
Do you remember where he came from? Who he played with or anything?
Do you remember Stan King at all, honey?
Years later when Chauncey had his own band, Stan King played drums.
What do you remember about him?
About Stan King, I don't remember.

You don't remember anything. Okay. I never heard of the man until I started researching you. Okay. Then we had another drummer named George Marsh who appeared... ... Okay then we have the Chicago Loopers made a record.
